subject: MPA gateway checklist & acceptance lane for Private Offer (AWS/GCP)
messages:
From: Claire Zhou <claire.z@heliumhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@heliumhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-21 09:12 PST
Subject: Request: MAP & acceptance checkpoints for AWS/GCP private offers

Hi Tessa / Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — HeliumHealth is keen to proceed down a private-offer route but procurement needs a clear mutual action plan (MAP) that covers evaluation acceptance gates, the marketplace private-offer steps (AWS + GCP), and the billing routing expectations.

Key asks from procurement:
- A checklist for marketplace private-offer submission and expected timelines (AWS and GCP).
- Invoice routing and whether we can split billing between AWS and GCP projects for our multi-cloud pilot.
- Acceptance criteria and a short staged-acceptance cadence (P0/P1 sign-off).

Can you share a first-pass MAP and any templates you typically use? Procurement copied above.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Zhou
Director, Platform Strategy
HeliumHealth

(Attachment: initial_requirements.csv)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhou <claire.z@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23 10:03 PST
Subject: RE: Request: MAP & acceptance checkpoints for AWS/GCP private offers

Claire — appreciate the clear asks. Drafting a MAP now and attaching a working spreadsheet (MPA_Draft_v1.xlsx). High-level proposal below; full detail in the doc + Google Doc link.

Proposed 8-week MAP (example):
1) Week 0: Commercial kick — finalize private-offer target (AWS vs GCP primary) and confirm billing emails / legal contacts.
2) Weeks 1–2: Technical evaluation — deploy eval instance, perf targets, and integration smoke tests.
3) Week 3: Acceptance checkpoint 1 (security/compliance evidence + perf snapshot).
4) Week 4: Marketplace private-offer submission (we own the submission; you provide billing account IDs).
5) Weeks 5–6: Procurement / legal review and DocuSign.
6) Week 7: Staged activation (25% capacity) — acceptance checkpoint 2 (usage/rate sanity).
7) Week 8: Full activation and invoice routing cutover.

Notes:
- For split billing we recommend routing invoices to your finance team per-cloud project; finance will need the marketplace seller ID and the billing contact.
- Attached: billing-routing-diagram.png shows suggested invoice path and accounting tags.

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Qp-MPA-HeliumHealth/edit (MPA draft + milestone tracker)

I also attached our AWS private-offer checklist for reference; Jordan will chime in on timing and marketplace ops.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: MPA_Draft_v1.xlsx; aws-private-offer-checklist.pdf)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhou <claire.z@heliumhealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-11-25 11:40 PST
Subject: RE: Request: MAP & acceptance checkpoints for AWS/GCP private offers

Claire — quick operational clarifications from the marketplace side:

- AWS private offers: typical submission-to-listing time is 5–10 business days once we upload the offer and accounting info is confirmed. We bundle the acceptance criteria in the offer metadata so procurement can see the ramp timeline.
- GCP marketplace private offers vary by region; for a cross-cloud pilot plan we suggest staged submissions (AWS first, GCP follow-on) to minimize billing complexity.

Action items for HeliumHealth to provide:
- AWS seller / buyer account IDs and billing contact.
- Confirmation on whether you want Redwood to receive invoices and re-bill (we can but it requires a reseller flow).

Attaching our internal checklist (aws-private-offer-checklist.pdf) and adding an estimated calendar view to the shared doc.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: aws-private-offer-checklist.pdf)

From: procurement@heliumhealth.com
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30 08:15 PST
Subject: RE: Request: MAP & acceptance checkpoints for AWS/GCP private offers

Tessa/Jordan — thanks for the draft. A few procurement clarifications:

1) We need the acceptance criteria documented as measurable tests (e.g., 95th percentile latency < 150ms for 512-token requests, embeddings similarity error < 2%).
2) We require invoice routing to the following: finance-payments@heliumhealth.com and AP contact (Maria Lopez) with PO references included. Can Redwood attach PO refs to marketplace invoices?
3) For split billing: HeliumHealth will run production on GCP and experiments on AWS for Q1; invoices must be split by cloud project ID. Please confirm support.

If you can update the MPA doc with the measurable acceptance checks and an example invoice with PO refs, we can sign off faster.

Procurement Team
HeliumHealth
(Attachment: hh_procurement_requirements.pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: procurement@heliumhealth.com, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01 09:22 PST
Subject: RE: Request: MAP & acceptance checkpoints for AWS/GCP private offers

Thanks — copying Finance notes below and next steps.

Finance / Billing response:
- We can include PO references on invoices if the buyer provides the PO text to attach during DocuSign.
- Split billing by cloud project ID is supported when the buyer provides distinct marketplace buyer IDs. We'll need those buyer IDs and the AP email to route invoices correctly.
- If HeliumHealth prefers Redwood to centrally handle billing and re-bill, we can propose a reseller flow but that will add an extra month to onboarding and requires a short reseller agreement.

Recommended next steps:
1) Claire / procurement supply: AWS buyer ID, GCP buyer ID, AP contact email, and the PO template (we can attach to DocuSign).
2) Redwood to update MPA doc with measurable acceptance tests (we've added perf targets and a short eval test plan — see Google Doc).
3) Tessa/Jordan to confirm timeline for AWS submission (targeting week-of 12/06) — Jordan, ok?

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/HeliumHealth/RDW-2026-0421 (we'll attach the PO example and acceptance checklist)

-Kimberly Park
Finance Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: billing-routing-diagram.png)

Claire
